chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding the man who enters with the woman.
then she claims upon him her dower, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'When he enters with her, then it demolishes the immediate (dower).'
ai.seo_question: Does sexual intercourse make the full dower immediately due to the wife in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that consummation (dakhala) triggers the immediate obligation of the full dower (mahr), distinguishing it from deferred portions. This ruling underscores the legal weight of physical intimacy in establishing financial rights, a principle derived from the Prophet's practice and elaborated by scholars like al-Kulayni to resolve disputes over partial payments. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the timing of dower disbursement in marital contracts.
